notes: IMPORTANT: ags.auroragov.org returns HTTP 403 to the default Python-urllib User-Agent - send a browser-like User-Agent header (curl's default UA works). City of Aurora official OpenData MapServer, current code (post-Oct 2019); layer 257 is 'Former Zoning (pre-October 2019)' - do not use. Covers all of Aurora across Arapahoe/Adams/Douglas. Also verified Adams-County portion (-104.8466,39.7400 -> MU-FB 'Mixed-Use Fitzsimons Boundary District') and SE Aurora (-104.7130,39.5700 -> PD 'Planned Development', NAME='EAGLE BEND'). For PD polygons NAME holds the PD name; Zone_Subzone/SUBZONE hold subareas.

County's own ArcGIS Server (ArapaMAP public viewer), layer 'Zoning - Unincorporated County'. Covers unincorporated land ONLY; returns no feature inside cities (Englewood test point returned 0). This layer holds only ACTIVE='Y' polygons (863). Alternate: CountyFeatureService/FeatureServer/24 has the same data plus 413 inactive/superseded polygons - if used, add where=ACTIVE='Y'. No description field; HYPERLINK points to the Land Development Code page for the district; CASE_NUMBER holds the rezoning case. Also verified Byers (-104.2275,39.7114 -> RR-A). Avoid third-party AGOL copies (tucker_lrewater, impactcommercial).

Douglas County GIS (org seTexOicoRXDvRsJ) hosted view; layers 0-3 are identical (934 features). Countywide polygons, but incorporated land is a placeholder: ZONE_TYPE='CTY', FIRST_DESC='INCORPORATED AREAS', TOWN_NAME=<city> - treat CTY as 'look up the municipal layer'. PD_Name holds the PD name (Highlands Ranch returns PD_Name='HIGHLANDS RANCH'; HR sub-planning areas are not in this layer). Also verified Franktown (-104.7525,39.3908 -> C 'COMMERCIAL'). Codes seen: A1,B,C,CMTY,CTY,D,ER,GI,HC,LI,LRR,LSB,MF,MI,NF,OS,PD,RR,SR.

City of Centennial own ArcGIS Server, Planning/Official_Zoning. Layer also carries setback/height/lot standards (MaxBuildingHeight, Minimum_Lot_Area, etc.) and a code URL (URL_1). MapServer/0 equivalent exists. A point at the civic center (-104.8433,39.5949) returned no feature (likely ROW gap) - expect misses on road right-of-way.

City of Englewood AGOL org (fjohnson_englewoodgov org 2gwTlp6STLlfLYIT). Most recently edited district-polygon layer (2024-06). TYPE = Residential/Commercial/etc.; PUDNUM for PUDs. Also verified -104.9810,39.6400 -> R-1-C. Same-org alternates: Base_Zoning_District_Boundaries/FeatureServer/2 (same districts plus long code-change text fields) and Parcels_Zoning/FeatureServer/0 (parcel-level, NEWZONE field, edited 2025-11). Avoid third-party OkeefeA_AyresAGO 'Zoning2022'.

City of Littleton AGOL (gis_littleton). Layer id is 195, not 0. Current code (Unified Land Use Code districts, edited 2026-02); links to encodeplus code sections in LINK/BASE_DIST_DESC etc. Littleton spans Arapahoe/Douglas/Jefferson - layer covers whole city. Also verified -105.0,39.6 -> MLR 'Medium Lot Residential'. Do NOT use ZoningUpdateDRAFT (2021 draft) or LittletonZoning_GET_8_23_21 (stale). Planned-development overlays: Zoning_PDO/FeatureServer/194 and PlannedDevelopment/FeatureServer/203.

City's own ArcGIS Server, Website_Public layer 'Zoning' (layer 27 is the colour-accessible duplicate). Parcel-based polygons: also returns FDP_PUD, SUBDIVISION, NEIGHBORHOOD, DESCRIPTION (actual use). Also verified -104.9028,39.6075 -> O-2 'Open Space'.

City of Sheridan AGOL org (planner_SheridanCO); this is the 'Zoning' layer of the city's official 'Zoning & Land Use' web map linked from ci.sheridan.co.us/443/Planning-Zoning (edited 2026-08). For PUDs Dist_Name may hold the PUD name instead of a district description (e.g. -105.013,39.648 -> Dist_id 'PUD', Dist_Name 'Broken Tee Golf Course'). Ordinance field holds the adopting ordinance.

No public queryable layer and no online zoning map. City states all property is zoned Planned Unit Development District (PUDD); zoning map available only on request from the City Clerk (glendale.co.us/156/Zoning). Fallback: return 'PUDD' for any point inside Glendale city limits; site-specific PUD terms require the City Clerk / Planning.

No public ArcGIS zoning layer found (city AGOL org E0FqgLpXCssDIjiF has only trails/sewer/wildlife). Official Zoning Map is a PDF at cherryhillsvillage.com/392/Zoning-District-Maps (adopted by Ord. 7 Series 2019, amended by later rezonings); city says it is informational only. Districts are mainly R-1 (2.5 ac), R-2, R-3 (1 ac), R-4 (1/2 ac), O-1 etc. Fallback: PDF map or call Community Development 303-783-2721. AGOL 'Zoning' hits under 'Cherry Hill' are Canton, MI - ignore.

No public ArcGIS zoning layer. Zoning map is Appendix A of the Zoning Code & Land Use Regulations (Nov 2020 PDF, columbinevalley.org/documents). Town uses a GovPilot GIS viewer (columbinevalley.org/maps), not ArcGIS REST. Districts: A, R-1, CC, MUPD, RPD, REPD, EPD. Fallback: PDF map or call the Town.

No public ArcGIS zoning layer. Zoning map PDF: townofbowmar.org/files/a98de9ba3/Exhibit+A-Town+of+Bow+Mar+Zoning+Map.pdf; code is Municipal Code Ch. 16 (Residential I/II, Recreational, Utility, Agricultural, PD). Town spans Arapahoe/Jefferson. Fallback: PDF map or call the Town Clerk.

No public ArcGIS zoning layer. Only map found is a Board-approved zoning map PDF from March 2010 (siterepository.s3.amazonaws.com/00343201005130309458886.pdf) - may be stale. Districts: PD, VC (Village Commercial), RR (Large Lot Rural Residential), RR SUP. Town is overwhelmingly RR. Fallback: PDF map or call the Town.

City of Lone Tree AGOL (GISAdmin@cityoflonetree.com). Layer id is 1 (layer 0 does not exist). planning_area holds PD name (e.g. 'Park Meadows', 'RidgeGate'); pd_doc links the PD document. Also verified -104.878,39.563 -> PD (Park Meadows) and -104.865,39.532 -> PD (RidgeGate). Older snapshot COLT_Zoning_July_2023 in same org - do not use.

Town of Parker AGOL (parkergis), public service (the *_Internal twin is not needed). ZONING holds the full district NAME, not a short code (values: AGRICULTURAL, CORRIDOR COMMERCIAL, DOWNTOWN EAST/WEST, LARGE-LOT RESIDENTIAL, LIGHT INDUSTRIAL, MIXED-USE COMMUNITY/NEIGHBORHOOD, MULTIFAMILY RESIDENTIAL, NEIGHBORHOOD COMMERCIAL, OPEN SPACE, PLANNED DEVELOPMENT, PUBLIC FACILITY, REGIONAL COMMERCIAL, DOUGLAS COUNTY). ZONING='DOUGLAS COUNTY' = unincorporated enclave -> fall through to Douglas County layer. PD_NAME/PD_DOC give the PD name and document (test: PD_NAME 'HORSESHOE RIDGE'). Also verified town hall -104.7614,39.5186 -> DOWNTOWN EAST. Layers 0 (Planned Developments) and 1 (Light Industrial Conservation District overlay) in same service.

Town of Castle Rock own ArcGIS Server (DataCatalog). ZONING field holds the district code or, for PDs, the PD name (e.g. -104.88,39.40 -> ZONING_CODE 'PD', ZONING 'MEADOWS THIRD AMENDMENT', TYPE 'PLANNED DEVELOPMENT', PDNUM 37). OVERLAY (e.g. DOWNTOWN), ZONING_URL and DA_URL also returned.

City of Castle Pines AGOL org (urlKey castlepines; publisher account jrhodes_civiclens). Coarse: one polygon per PD/area, not lot-level. Name holds the PD/area name (test: 'Castle Pines North'); zoning_ordinance_docs links the PD binder. Code values: A1, B, ER, PDPP, PDU. Note the 'Service Name' is Zoning_ with a trailing underscore.
